title: Appointment for UK Societas and restoration
text:
You can use this form to make an appointment to a UK Societas or when dealing with a restoration case.

 Before you file

 All directors must verify their identity to prove who they are. You’ll need to give the Companies House personal code for the director and confirm they have verified their identity.

 See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 Nationalities and countries

 Use our list of nationalities and countries to complete your form. We’ll only accept entries from this standard list.
